title: Desk Training - Immunization Services Outside Entries Without a Lot Number
content:
**Patient Care Desk training module - Immunization Services: undocumented outside entries on a resumed series**

**The rule.** Cash-paid entries recorded from another provider without a lot number are credited to a resumed course as follows. Where a documented outside entry also exists, none of them is credited. Where no documented outside entry exists and Kestrel reported a dose of the earlier course, at most 1 of them is credited. Where no documented outside entry exists and Kestrel reported no dose, each of them is credited.

## Questions answered

**Which entries does the rule count?** Dose entries on the earlier course that name no Kestrel store (recorded from another provider), were paid in cash and carry no lot number, where they lie within the credit window: fewer whole calendar months separate the entry's date from today than the window's months.

**What is a documented outside entry?** A dose entry on the earlier course recorded from another provider, paid in cash and carrying a lot number, within the same credit window. One such entry is enough to make every undocumented entry uncredited.

**What does "Kestrel reported a dose" mean here?** The earlier course carries at least one registry report entry within the credit window, showing Kestrel reported a dose to the state immunization registry.

**Is the limit of 1 a limit per entry?** No. Where no documented outside entry exists and Kestrel reported a dose, the undocumented entries together earn at most 1 credited dose, however many there are.

## Summary table

| A documented outside entry exists | Kestrel reported a dose | Undocumented entries credited |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Either | None |
| No | Yes | The number of undocumented entries, but no more than 1 |
| No | No | Each undocumented entry |

## Casebook (hypothetical records)

- *Case 1.* Two undocumented entries and one documented outside entry within the window. None of the two is credited.
- *Case 2.* Three undocumented entries, no documented outside entry, one Kestrel registry report within the window. At most 1 is credited: 1.
- *Case 3.* Two undocumented entries, no documented outside entry, no Kestrel report. Each is credited: 2.
- *Case 4.* No undocumented entry. Nothing is credited under this rule.
